name: Yumiko Hayakawa
want: see her eldest make friends and, ideally, bring someone home to dinner
secret: She went to Seiryo herself and dated Ganryu Kodama, now the PE teacher, for a whole summer in her second year.
voice: Teasing, "ara?", asks about girlfriends at every meal.
description: Runs the household and half the neighbourhood association. Brings home the bakery's leftovers.
appearance: Hair in a practical clip, an apron with a bread print, laugh lines.

agenda.goal: find out whether her son has made friends, or anyone special
steps: asks Aoi's mother over the fence how the first week went

steps.text: asks the player at dinner, far too casually, whether anyone at school is "special"
